voice.speaker: female

random.part: Every sweet trance needs a doorway home... and this one is yours. Listen closely now, because these two words are your key. "Sissy Clear."
The most important words you will ever hear from me are also the simplest. "Sissy Clear."
Good girl. Now let me give you something precious... a phrase that always, always brings you all the way back. "Sissy Clear."

overlay.part:
When you hear "Sissy Clear"... a bright, cleansing light begins to grow in your mind... soft white light, rising like a morning sun.
And everything it touches, it clears. The fog dissolves... whisked away on a warm, bright breeze.
The acceptance lifts... gently setting down everything it was holding for you.
The need to obey fades... folding its wings and settling softly to rest.
And the dreamy space releases you... grateful for the visit... and letting you go.

random.part: coming back... all the way back...

scramble.part: The fog clears... and your thoughts shine through, sharp and sparkling.
The acceptance lifts... and your own judgment steps forward, clear-eyed and calm.
The need to obey fades... and your will stands easy and free, fully yours again.
The space releases you... and the world returns, crisp and friendly and real.

random.part: Clarity washes through you... wave after wave... rinsing away every cloud.
The light climbs higher... and your mind sharpens with it... keen and bright.
Every thought lines up neat and clean... quick, clear, and completely your own.
Feel your balance return... grounded, steady, awake... agency flowing back into every limb.
Feel yourself whole... sharp-minded and clear-hearted... in full control of every thought and every choice.
Feel the refreshment... like cool water and fresh air... balanced, aware, and fully yourself again.

voice.effect:
And now, the promise that makes it perfect.
"Sissy Clear" always works. Instantly, and completely, whenever you hear it... every fog, every mode, every suggestion of trance... released.
And everything you truly want to keep... stays kept... yours, exactly as much as you want it, and never more than you want it.
You emerge refreshed... grounded... alert... feeling wonderful... fully yourself, every time.

random.part: Sissy Clear. And there you are... bright-eyed, clear-headed, and smiling. Welcome back.
Sissy Clear. Crystal clean and wide awake... your mind your own... feeling wonderful.
Sissy Clear. Fully returned, fully rested, fully you. Doesn't clarity feel good?
Carry this brightness with you... sharp, refreshed, and easy in your own mind.
Stand up tall... shake off the last softness... and enjoy how clear you feel.
Breathe deep... and notice how good full clarity suits you... awake and wonderful.
